description: This file defines the abstract class ModelForm, which is a core part of the OFBiz widget modeling framework. It represents a form widget that models the <form> and <grid> elements in XML. The class is responsible for parsing XML element definitions, managing form fields, actions, styles, pagination, and other form-related properties, and providing accessors for these configurations. It is used as a foundation for specific form implementations in OFBiz, encapsulating form structure and behavior as immutable data structures.

classes.name: ModelForm
classes.description: This class models a form widget, encapsulating properties such as fields, actions, styles, pagination, and behavior as read-only, immutable data structures. It provides methods to access its configuration and manage form elements as parsed from XML.
